dependency_semantics: dependency_ids are scientific prerequisites for final resolution, not prohibitions on parallel preparatory work; GAP-05 depends on GAP-08 only for observed coexistence, while analytical bounds may begin earlier

required_inputs: Versioned strongest applicable H0b from GAP-07
independently calibrated and locked NiTi/contact/membrane/pressure parameters from GAP-03/04
feasible coexistence domain and identifiable local channels from GAP-05/02/06
untouched held-out pressure-curvature-temperature paths, measurement uncertainty and predeclared tolerances
required_outputs: Verified H0b code and convergence/implementation checks
blind forward predictions and signed residual/discrimination report
gaps.pass_criterion: A complete, converged locked H0b prediction is compared with untouched held-out global and local data, with uncertainty-aware predeclared metrics; the adequacy or systematic-failure outcome is classifiable.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If H0b is adequate, stop the distinct H1 mechanics claim (Outcome A). If locked H0b fails with independent local mechanism correlation, permit only a subsequent H1 formulation/test (Outcome B). If uncertainty or missing channels prevents discrimination, redesign/narrow (Outcome C); never rescue failure by refitting validation data.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; only a named missing implementation detail for the selected published formulation may trigger targeted retrieval.

required_inputs: Sealed-bundle channel feasibility and perturbation estimates from GAP-08
temperature/rate/history control plan from GAP-06
candidate mechanism signatures from H0b sensitivity analysis and calibration pilots
artifact controls for membrane, clamps and cross-section shape
required_outputs: Observability/identifiability matrix with sensitivities and expected noise
minimum channel set and null/positive controls
pilot data demonstrating independent mechanism readouts
gaps.pass_criterion: At least one direct or independently validated slip measure and one transformation-sensitive measure, with local temperature, section-shape/membrane and fixture controls, distinguish prespecified competing mechanism signatures above uncertainty in the operating domain.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If only global loops or mutually confounded proxies remain, H1 coupling is untestable here; redesign instrumentation or narrow to predictive H0b validity without mechanistic attribution.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted measurement-method retrieval only if an exact proposed sensor method lacks a technical feasibility basis in the corpus.

gaps.current_status: OPEN_BLOCKING; p is boundary input, not known f_n
required_inputs: Actual bundle packing/geometry and feasible pressure-curvature range
membrane pressure-displacement/traction response
independent pull-out or direct-shear response across pressure; optional contact-pressure proxy
cross-section contact model with uncertainty and nonuniqueness analysis
required_outputs: Calibrated pressure-transfer/contact-traction map or bounded latent-contact model
uncertainty envelope propagated to H0b predictions
gaps.pass_criterion: Independent non-validation tests constrain effective normal traction or its prediction-relevant bounds over the declared domain sufficiently that H0b adequacy conclusions are robust to the remaining p-to-f_n uncertainty.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If distinct contact-force maps fit calibration data but reverse the H0b verdict, return to measurement/model redesign; do not substitute chamber p for f_n or freely fit transmission to bending validation.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted retrieval only for a named missing membrane/contact property or calibration method required by the selected apparatus.

gaps.current_status: OPEN_BLOCKING; lock is protocol, not measured
required_inputs: Separate single-wire thermomechanical tests for transformation parameters
direct-shear/pull-out friction tests for mu
GAP-03 pressure-transfer and membrane characterization
geometry, packing, prestrain, clamp/compliance characterization
explicit calibration/validation data partition
required_outputs: Parameter provenance table, estimates, covariance/ranges and physical bounds
frozen model version and parameter file with calibration-only provenance
gaps.pass_criterion: Every influential H0b parameter is measured or bounded from independent calibration data; joint sensitivity shows the held-out decision is robust over remaining parameter ranges; model and parameters are frozen before held-out acquisition/unblinding.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If mu, pressure transfer, transformation or contact parameters remain mutually compensating enough to reverse the test, improve calibration or narrow prediction domain. Validation refitting declares the version failed and requires a new version/new untouched validation set.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted retrieval only for a named, necessary material limit unavailable in existing corpus and direct calibration.

required_inputs: W02 transformation strain/curvature estimate as a planning bound, not a universal threshold
actual wire diameter, prestrain, phase state and fatigue/membrane limits
sealed prototype with GAP-08 viable diagnostic channels
pressure, curvature, temperature and cycle-history measurements
required_outputs: Instrumented feasibility map of p-kappa-T and cycle count
evidence for simultaneous local slip and transformation with specimen-integrity record
gaps.pass_criterion: A repeatable, sealed, safe operating region demonstrates temporally overlapping inter-wire slip and independently supported transformation over enough cycles for validation, with prespecified specimen-integrity limits.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If no accessible durable coexistence region exists, stop the current MP1 coupling-core formulation; narrow to a single-mechanism/model-validity question or redesign apparatus. An analytical threshold alone does not pass.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted retrieval only if a specific safety/fatigue/material limit needed for the pilot is absent from corpus and cannot be measured.

required_inputs: Local and ambient temperature channel feasibility
rate sweeps, dwell/cooling and repeated-cycle pilots
training history and wear tracking
fixture and membrane-only controls
required_outputs: decision whether isothermal approximation is valid or thermomechanical H0b is required
gaps.pass_criterion: Temperature and rate effects are measured and bounded below the predeclared discrimination margin, or explicitly represented in a locked thermomechanical H0b; cycle history and wear are controlled or stratified.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If temperature/rate/history effects can explain purported H0b residuals, no H1 inference; add thermomechanics/controls or restrict the domain. A nominal quasi-static rate by itself is insufficient.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted retrieval only for a named missing thermal property or measurement-method requirement.

required_inputs: Existing repository full text/extractions for Barsi 2025, Tjahjanto 2017, Xin Liu 2004, Kang 2020 and Vahidi 2022
MP1 geometry, loading, confinement and H0b constitutive options
published governing equations, contact assumptions and applicability limits
required_outputs: Formulation crosswalk and strongest applicable H0b specification
adaptation/implementation feasibility verdict with explicit assumptions
gaps.pass_criterion: A competent baseline is selected or constructed from the strongest applicable published cable/contact or FE formulation, including transformation-aware NiTi, frictional contact and membrane traction; limitations are explicit and implementation can be verified.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If an existing formulation already supplies the alleged missing coupling term, withdraw that H1 rationale. If no formulation applies, document the precise failure of applicability before opening a bounded model-extension task; do not infer H1 merely from implementation difficulty.
gaps.search_trigger: CONDITIONAL TARGETED RETRIEVAL ONLY if the exact governing equations or applicability conditions of a named existing formulation are absent from repository full text; no broad search.

required_inputs: Actual sleeve and feedthrough design, pressure/seal limits and wire packing
candidate nonintrusive/local channels: optical tracking or end-slip, strain/transformation proxy, thermometry, section geometry
sensor calibration, noise and perturbation estimates
required_outputs: Sealed-sensor prototype and leak/packing perturbation report
gaps.pass_criterion: At least one validated slip channel plus a transformation-sensitive channel and required temperature/geometry controls operate in a sealed bundle without materially changing baseline mechanics beyond quantified uncertainty.
gaps.fail_or_narrow_criterion: If channels cannot operate without leakage or changing packing, redesign instrumentation; if no discriminating local/auxiliary set is possible, stop H1-style mechanism claims from global M-kappa alone.
gaps.search_trigger: NO NEW SEARCH; targeted retrieval only for a named sensor/feedthrough method whose physical feasibility is undocumented in the repository.
